2. Service Description & Local Execution

TECHTIS provides a comprehensive suite of 40 client-side PDF, document, and image utilities. All operations are conducted locally on your computer or mobile device using modern WebAssembly, Canvas, and HTML5 browser capabilities. TECHTIS does not host, upload, or inspect your private files.

3. Important Disclaimers for Special Tools

Passport & Visa Photo Maker:

While our presets strictly adhere to published international guidelines (e.g. India Passport Seva 35x45mm, US Department of State 2x2 inch, UK/Schengen ICAO 9303), TECHTIS does not guarantee automatic visa or passport approval by governmental authorities. Embassy guidelines regarding facial expressions, shadows, jewelry, and eye wear must be observed by the applicant. When printing the A4 sheet, users must select "Actual Size" / 100% scale in their print dialog.

Private Document OCR (Aadhaar & PAN):

Optical Character Recognition (OCR) is inherently probabilistic and dependent on input photo resolution, lighting, and camera angle. Users must independently verify all recognized names, identification numbers, and dates of birth before utilizing extracted data in official or legal contexts.
